mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the outstanding newspapers in Nigeria."
The Guardian newspaper is one of the outstanding newspapers in Nigeria.

fib: ______ means laying no previous or prior censorship of publication.
Liberty of the press means laying no previous or prior censorship of publication.
______ are known for misspelling, wrong judgment and insufficient coverage.
Nigerian newspapers and magazines are known for misspelling, wrong judgment and insufficient coverage.

Examples are the national dailies - Vanguard, The Guardian etc, and media houses such as NTA, FRCN, and so on.
